name: Towada Yae
source: [spoiler] She comes to Hinamizawa so that she could kill her boyfriend, Takumi Kurosawa, in a secluded area. She is found by Akira Otobe and "Mion Sonozaki" in a meeting hall near the Furude Shrine, causing her to hastily attempt to cover up her murder.[/spoiler]
